$comment: HAND-EDITED source of which settings an agent may change (MCP settings_set and settings_reset, the socket's cli/mcp/script/remote writers; plans/cmux-next/settings-react.md section 3). Every key of the schema is in exactly one group, with no default: SettingsSchemaExportTests fails on a key in none or in two, so a new setting cannot reach agents without a decision. A group's agent is settable (an agent may set and reset its keys: looks and layout, usually) or the refusal that says why not (one of refusals). The settings schema export writes agent_settable and agent_refusal per row from it; scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift copy the app enforces at its one write path (SettingsSchema+AgentPolicy.generated.swift: SettingsSchema.agentSettableKeys, agentRefusedKeys, SettingWriter).

refusals.doc: The key decides what leaves the machine or what is recorded.
The key opens network access or egress.
The key can end terminals or other work.
The person decides it; agents do not, in v1 (picker.pinned: which folders the picker offers first).
